RAG Knowledge Ledger sample document.

This plain text file exercises the native text parser and the built-in
chunkers with unstructured paragraph content, padded out with a few
extra sentences so a small configured chunk size actually produces more
than one chunk during tests.

For automated PII detector tests, a synthetic contact address is used:
canary.leaktest@example.com. This address is fictional and does not
correspond to a real mailbox.

A synthetic phone number for the same purpose is 555-010-1199, a North
American reserved fictional exchange never assigned to a real line.

Final paragraph confirms the document has more than one section, so
chunk boundaries and overlap behavior have real content to operate on
during tests.
